mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stop falling and move up from their current depressed levels, commuting traffic will feed weekday trips to shops and eateries, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days despite a sustained rise in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A continued rise in RESIDENTIAL time with flat or weaker mobility elsewhere indicates more time spent near home, which substitutes local shopping and small errands into retail venues and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated or increases further and WORKPLACES remains weak.

mechanism_narrative: A further week-on-week drop in TRANSIT below its current already-low level will mechanically cut access to shopping districts and reduce RETAIL_REC over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -55 on a weekly mean
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 28 days after TRANSIT crosses below -55 on a weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS remains deeply suppressed but no longer deteriorates, leisure substitution shifts away from outdoor recreation and toward indoor retail trips, nudging RETAIL_REC upward over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS is above -80 and improving by at least 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve over the next 7 days after PARKS improves by at least 2 points from an already depressed level.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC both stabilize after weeks of decline, the shared trip pattern signals broader local errand recovery that will lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over the next 28 days while GROCERY_PHARM also remains weak or declines further.

mechanism_narrative: A broad fall in WORKPLACES together with TRANSIT signals renewed mobility suppression from restrictions or compliance fatigue, which will drag RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -45 and TRANSIT falls below -52 in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT breach the stated thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: As residential confinement eases and WORKPLACES losses stop deepening, discretionary retail trips return with a lag, so RETAIL_REC will be higher over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior four-week mean over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL eases and WORKPLACES stabilizes or improves.

mechanism_narrative: In a hot-weather or rain-affected regime, persistent weakness in PARKS and TRANSIT shifts outings toward indoor retail and nearby shopping, producing a short-run increase in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within 14 days while PARKS remains very low and TRANSIT remains near or below its current level.
